nom: fresh Lotus Youth Preserve Exfoliating Face Toner

segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive or reactive skin, including some cautious about glycolic acid or other AHA exfoliants, consistently report no stinging, burning or irritation, describing the toner as gentle enough for daily use.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin, including one managing winter flakiness, report the toner hydrates without irritation and helps even out skin tone and fade dark spots.
segments.oily: The one reviewer who explicitly describes her skin as oily, alongside sensitive, reports the toner is non-comedogenic, has not caused a single breakout, and leaves her skin clear, hydrated and glowing.
segments.normal: The one reviewer who describes her skin as normal reports the toner smoothed fine lines and brightened her complexion, though she noticed results plateauing after a few weeks and recommends cycling it in and out of a routine.

concerns.aging: A couple of reviewers, including one nearing 40 who wanted to keep fine lines at bay, report the toner helps smooth and reduce the visible appearance of fine lines with continued use.
concerns.dehydration: Nearly every reviewer describes the toner as strongly hydrating rather than drying, including several using it specifically for dry, winter-parched or flaky skin, with many noting it leaves skin plump and soft rather than tight.
concerns.redness: Many reviewers, including some with sensitive or acne-prone skin, report reduced redness or no redness at all after use.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer with sensitive skin reports no damage to her skin barrier despite this being an exfoliating formula.
concerns.spots: Many reviewers report visible fading of dark spots, hyperpigmentation and post-acne marks within one to several weeks of regular use; one reviewer needed more time to see results and had not yet noticed fading.
concerns.blemishes: Most reviewers report no new breakouts, several explicitly noting a non-comedogenic feel; one reviewer, however, developed breakouts and welts beside her nose after around 90 days of use and had to stop, with her skin clearing about a week later.
concerns.oiliness: One reviewer reports the toner helps keep her face from feeling oily by the end of the day.

aspects.libelle: Mild tingle on application that fades quickly
Helps other routine products absorb better

extraits.texte: I really wanted to like this because I like Fresh products, but it didn't work for me. I used it for 90 days hoping i was just purging, but i wasn't, it made me break out and gave me small welts on each side of my nose :/. it smells amazing though. Unfortunately i had to stop using it. A week after i stopped using it my skin started to heal. Even though it didn't work for me, it might work for someone else.

This toner is perfect for anyone with oily, sensitive skin. It's non-comedogenic and hasn't caused a single breakout. The weightless texture absorbs fast and leaves my skin hydrated without any sticky residue. It's refreshing, hydrating, and keeps my skin clear and glowing. I've received this toner complimentary from Fresh and absolutely love it!

This toner is PACKED with multiple benefits that I'm looking for! I have normal skin, and I'm turning 40 this year. I have fine lines that I want to keep at bay so this helped smooth my skin over with added benefits of brightening and overall evening of my complexion. The daily exfoliation has been a phenomenal benefit but I noticed results started to plateau after a few weeks so it's important to switch it out and bring it back into rotation for you to notice results again. Complimentary from Fresh Beauty for an honest review.

I have been looking for a gently toner that doesn't irritate my dry skin and thus is seriously my savior. It really hydrated my skin after just one use and my skin tone looks way mor even. Definitely give this one a try if you're in the market for one. Gifted by fresh beauty

My skin is easily prone to acne and is quite sensitive, so I really value how this toner provides hydration, enhances brightness, and evens out my complexion. The lotus extract is very soothing and helps reduce redness. I've also observed that the pores on my cheeks and forehead seem smaller and tighter when I wake up. I also appreciate that it's formulated with clean and safe ingredients. Gifted by Fresh Beauty.

Amazed! I really loved this toner. The texture was very nice. And my skin absorbed it very well. Even though it's an exfoliating toner I did not feel any damage to my barrier nor did it sting even though I have sensitive skin. Complimentary from freshbeauty

Definitely a Dream Toner! I love how this soaked right in. Leaving my skin uber hydrated and glass like. Pores absolutely minimized and texture super smooth. Needed a little more use time to fade dark spots but I have I hopes! Complimentary from Fresh.
